answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking: each agent must lock real collateral before it may act, the way a merchant once posted copper ingots as surety before a long voyage. Spawning a thousand sybil identities then means funding a thousand separate bonds, and any agent caught attesting falsely has its deposit slashed. Like smelting pure metal away from worthless ferrous slag, the ledger burns bad actors stakes, so fake-identity fleets become ruinously expensive instead of free.
